services.name: Field Trips
services.desc: This summer, we are creating a Field of Flags at Coggeshall Farm Museum and our partner, Old Sturbridge Village! Through this initiative, we raise essential funds to support our participation in the Blue Star Museum program, allowing us to offer free admission to active-duty and retired military personnel and their families at both Coggeshall Farm Museum and Old Sturbridge Village. In 2025, more than 7,100 visitors experienced Coggeshall Farm Museum and Old Sturbridge thanks to the generosity of people like you!
